stages.name: Define the work
stages.description: Clarify the outcome, requirements and acceptance contract.

stages.name: Plan & coordinate
stages.description: Split work, choose ownership and schedule agent execution.

stages.name: Supply context
stages.description: Provide project knowledge, instructions, skills and durable state.

stages.name: Implement
stages.description: Use coding agents, developer tools and executable environments.

stages.name: Verify behaviour
stages.description: Exercise code, tests, browsers, structural rules and security checks.

stages.name: Review & understand
stages.description: Inspect the result, recover understanding and make acceptance decisions.

stages.name: Integrate & release
stages.description: Gate merges, repair CI, deploy and check the integrated result.

stages.name: Observe & improve
stages.description: Use production feedback, failures, cost and quality to improve the loop.

stages.name: Harness & access
stages.description: Cross-cutting orchestration infrastructure, isolation and permissions.
